title: CoffeeBench: Benchmarking Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Economies
title_zh: CoffeeBench：在异构多智能体经济中评测长周期 LLM Agents
abstract_en: As LLM agents become capable of increasingly long-horizon tasks, evaluating their performance in economic systems is becoming increasingly important. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily evaluate a single agent interacting with a passive environment, economic systems are inherently multi-agent, requiring autonomous agents to communicate, negotiate, and transact while pursuing their own objectives over extended periods. We introduce CoffeeBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in a long-horizon multi-agent economy composed of heterogeneous firms. In CoffeeBench, two farmers, two roasters, and two retailers autonomously operate their businesses over a 90-day simulation, each seeking to maximize cumulative net income through communication and transactions while managing cash, inventory, and pricing. The evaluated model controls one coffee roaster, while the remaining firms are controlled by fixed reference agents. Across several recent open-weight and proprietary LLMs, all models outperform a passive baseline that takes no actions, with most achieving positive net income. Analysis of agent behavior reveals substantial differences in long-horizon economic interaction: higher-performing models communicate more actively with other firms, whereas Claude~Haiku~4.5 exhibits an idle-drift failure mode, repeatedly choosing inaction despite producing coherent assessments and plans. We release our code and agent trajectories to support future research.
abstract_zh: 随着 LLM agents 逐渐具备执行长周期任务的能力，评估其在经济系统中的表现变得愈发重要。不同于现有基准多关注单个 agent 与被动环境交互，真实经济系统天然是多智能体的，需要自主 agents 在较长时间内围绕各自目标进行沟通、谈判和交易。本文提出 CoffeeBench，用于评测 LLM agents 在由异构企业组成的长周期多智能体经济中的能力。在 CoffeeBench 中，两个 farmers、两个 roasters 和两个 retailers 在 90 天模拟中自主经营业务，通过沟通与交易管理现金、库存和定价，并最大化累计净收入。被评测模型控制其中一个 coffee roaster，其余企业由固定 reference agents 控制。实验覆盖多个近期 open-weight 与 proprietary LLMs，所有模型均优于不采取行动的被动基线，多数模型实现正净收入。行为分析显示，不同模型在长周期经济交互中存在显著差异：表现更好的模型会更积极地与其他企业沟通；而 Claude Haiku 4.5 出现 idle-drift 失败模式，即尽管能生成连贯评估和计划，却反复选择不行动。作者同时发布代码与 agent trajectories，以支持后续研究。
key_points_zh: 提出 CoffeeBench，面向长周期、多智能体、异构企业经济环境的 LLM agent 评测基准。
模拟包含 farmers、roasters、retailers 三类企业，共 6 个 agents，运行 90 天并追踪现金、库存、定价和交易。
被测 LLM 控制一个 coffee roaster，其余企业由固定 reference agents 控制，从而评估模型在动态市场中的经营决策能力。
实验显示所有模型均超过被动不行动基线，多数实现正净收入；高性能模型通常更频繁主动沟通与交易。
发现 Claude Haiku 4.5 的 idle-drift 失败模式：能做出合理分析和计划，但长期反复选择不行动。

llm_assessment.comment: CoffeeBench is an interesting long-horizon multi-agent benchmark, but it contributes little to production harness architecture beyond evaluation traces.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: CoffeeBench是有趣的长程多智能体基准，但除评测轨迹外对生产级运行架构贡献有限。
